data.one_liner: A pure‑Dart library for generating QR code data and image matrices.
data.what_it_does: It creates QR code payloads with configurable error correction and ECI support, then produces a module matrix that can be rendered manually. The API is immutable and works on all Dart platforms.
use_when: You need to generate QR codes in pure Dart or Flutter without a ready‑made widget
You want full control over rendering the QR modules yourself
You require ECI (Extended Channel Interpretation) or custom payload building
avoid_when: You need a ready‑made Flutter widget for QR display
strengths: Supports all QR versions (1‑40) and error‑correction levels
Pure Dart, works on all platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in Flutter widget, you must render the matrix yourself
Breaking API changes in recent major versions

alternatives.name: qr_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a ready‑made Flutter widget to render QR codes directly

alternatives.name: pretty_qr_code
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a customizable Flutter widget with additional styling options
